description: Repository module for styio-all-in-one ecosystem monorepo imports and cross-repository integration checks.
open_source_components: Node.js package manifests where imported modules require them

ci_gate_contract.submit_readiness: A styio-all-in-one integration snapshot is submittable when `platform-adaptation / linux-ci-gate`, `test / smoke`, and `test / golden-standard` all pass.

industry_references: LLVM Testing Infrastructure Guide: whole-program tests and reference-output comparison
SLSA producing artifacts: consistent build process across integrated outputs

resource_classes.description: Owns imported Styio, Pafio, and Vityo source trees inside the all-in-one repository.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Imported upstream source must preserve repository-local licenses, notices, and module boundaries.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Cross-repository imports must be updated through explicit promotion commits instead of silent partial tree replacement.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Missing imported project trees are blocking because the monorepo cannot represent ecosystem integration without them.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Generated build outputs and imported transient artifacts must stay outside tracked source.

transitions.on: run monorepo ci and audit gates

invalid_operations: replace one project tree without integration evidence

required_tests: monorepo build and smoke tests for imported Styio, Pafio, and Vityo surfaces
